notices.title: Midterm Examination Schedule Announcement
notices.description: The timetable and room arrangements for the upcoming Midterm Examination have been finalized. Students are requested to bring their student ID cards and standard stationery items. Electronic devices are strictly prohibited in the exam hall.

notices.title: Science Exhibition 2025 – Registrations Open
notices.description: Scholix Annual Science Fair will be hosted on November 15th. Students from Grades 8 to 10 are invited to submit team project abstracts in Robotics, Clean Energy, and Environmental Tech by the end of this month.

notices.title: Diwali & Midterm Break Holidays
notices.description: The school will remain closed from October 28th to November 4th on account of the festival of Diwali and midterm break. Classes will resume punctually on Wednesday, November 5th.

notices.title: Special Mathematics Problem-Solving Workshop
notices.description: An advanced problem-solving workshop for Grade 10 students preparing for state and national mathematics contests will be conducted every Saturday from 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM in Room 302.

notices.title: CodeCraft Hackathon Winners Felicitations
notices.description: Congratulations to our Grade 10 student team led by Aarav Sharma for securing 2nd prize at the Inter-School CodeCraft Web Development Hackathon! The trophies will be presented during Monday morning assembly.
